About me

Growing up with the internet, my screen time report was practically a cry for help. Little did anyone know, all those hours spent doomscrolling, watching trends come and go, dissecting ads and wondering why one reel had 4 million views while another had 400 were going to become rather useful.

Fast-forward a few years, I now work on the other side of that screen. Building brands, designing content, working on campaigns and figuring out how to compel people to buy things they didn't know they needed. Crazy how I went from being the target audience to the person figuring out how to target the audience.
